description: Build and save the evidence matrix and GO decision table artifacts for the D15 late-transcription hypothesis
code:
import pandas as pd, os, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
outdir = "/agent/jobs/0cf15093-9d08-4baf-925b-56add648ad8e/provenance"
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

ev = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(pmid="1095368", year=1975, type="direct assay (in vitro transcription)", stance="refutes",
      claim="Nicks/gaps in T5 DNA are a direct template requirement for late transcription",
      finding="Nicked vs ligase-sealed T5+ DNA transcribed by E. coli RNAP holoenzyme +/- rho gave no nick-specific difference in transcript size or sequences read",
      context="purified T5+ DNA, E. coli RNAP holoenzyme, in vitro",
      confidence="High for the assay; moderate for in vivo relevance (no C2, no gpT5.026, no replication fork present)"),
 dict(pmid="430606 / 430607", year=1979, type="mutant phenotype (genetics)", stance="refutes",
      claim="Single-strand interruptions are needed for late gene expression",
      finding=">60 interruption-deficient T5 mutants, including ones essentially free of interruptions genome-wide, are all viable; >=2 genes make the interruptions",
      context="T5 on E. coli, hydroxylamine mutagenesis, agarose gel DNA structure screen",
      confidence="High; caveat that the assay reports interruptions in mature virion DNA, not in the replicating concatemer template"),
 dict(pmid="2419589", year=1986, type="mutant phenotype + inhibitor", stance="supports indirect",
      claim="A replication block that leaves D15 intact still blocks late expression",
      finding="gyrB(Ts) at 42C, novobiocin, coumermycin A1 and nalidixic acid inhibit T5 mainly by blocking replication; late T5 genes were barely expressed",
      context="E. coli gyrA/gyrB(Ts) hosts, T5 infection",
      confidence="High for the phenotype; the abstract does not state whether late RNA or only late protein was scored"),
 dict(pmid="219226 / 224043", year=1979, type="mutant phenotype + direct assay", stance="supports indirect",
      claim="The late-expression block is specific to the D15 nuclease",
      finding="Gene D5 (a dsDNA-binding protein, not a nuclease) is also required for replication AND for late gene expression; purified gpD5 required to initiate late-region transcription",
      context="T5-infected E. coli; purified gpD5",
      confidence="High; shows the phenotype is shared across replication proteins"),
 dict(pmid="6248541", year=1980, type="interaction / co-purification", stance="qualifies",
      claim="D15 acts directly at the late transcription template",
      finding="~5e6 Da complex from T5-infected cells contains host RNAP, gpC2, gpD9 (Pol), gpD5 and gpD15, plus 2-3% of the genome as protected duplex DNA",
      context="T5-infected E. coli lysate fractionation",
      confidence="Moderate; association only, no catalytic requirement demonstrated. JBC 1980: no PMC, no DOI in PubMed, abstract only"),
 dict(pmid="330881 / 894794 / 6287031", year=1977, type="structural mapping", stance="qualifies/refutes",
      claim="Interruptions are reproducible and promoter-proximal",
      finding="4-5 principal sites (7.9, 18.5, 32.6, 64.8, 99.6%) present in 80-90% of molecules, ~20 minor sites, mean 8 per genome, 'variable but nonrandom'; one site reproducible to within 0.2% of genome length",
      context="T5 DNA, EM after ExoIII, agarose electrophoresis after ExoIII/S1",
      confidence="High for positions; occupancy is fractional"),
 dict(pmid="computed (AY587007)", year=2026, type="computational (this work)", stance="refutes",
      claim="Interruptions are positioned to license late promoters",
      finding="Distances from the 5 principal interruptions to the nearest annotated virion/morphogenesis gene start: 10.6, 2.3, 19.4, 7.2, 10.8 kb. No principal interruption lies inside the late structural cluster (70.7-86.6% of the genome). 5 late promoters were mapped by EM (PMID 745595) vs ~8 interruptions genome-wide",
      context="GenBank AY587007, 121,752 bp, 168 CDS; late-gene starts used as proxy for late promoters",
      confidence="Moderate; late promoter base coordinates from 1978/1983 were not retrievable, proxy used"),
 dict(pmid="4522782", year=1974, type="direct assay (in vivo DNA)", stance="refutes",
      claim="Nicks persist on the template into the late period",
      finding="Parental T5 interruptions are sealed in vivo starting ~6 min after infection, independently of DNA replication",
      context="labelled parental T5 DNA in infected E. coli",
      confidence="High"),
 dict(pmid="904023", year=1977, type="mutant phenotype + enzymology", stance="qualifies",
      claim="D15 creates the interruptions",
      finding="D15 is NOT needed to make unit-length single strands from concatemers; it IS needed for the later single-stranded fragments. Purified D15 cuts mature T5 DNA only when pre-existing interruptions are present",
      context="T5-infected E. coli; purified D15",
      confidence="High; places D15 downstream of nicking"),
 dict(pmid="24198424", year=2014, type="proteomic/bioinformatic", stance="refutes",
      claim="D15 is the enzyme that makes the genomic interruptions",
      finding="A dedicated nicking endonuclease, identified among capsid-maturation functions, is responsible for the single-strand interruptions in the T5 genome",
      context="T5 virion proteomics + bioinformatics + immuno-EM",
      confidence="Moderate-high; assignment is proteomic/bioinformatic, not a nickase-null phenotype"),
 dict(pmid="32722583", year=2020, type="direct assay (interaction/in vitro)", stance="competing",
      claim="Late transcription is licensed by template structure",
      finding="All three T5 temporal classes use host RNAP with sigma70; gpT5.026 binds the RNAP beta subunit and its disruption lowers late and raises early transcripts, i.e. a protein-factor switch",
      context="T5-infected E. coli, purified RNAP, gene-026 disruption mutant",
      confidence="High; supplies a protein-based alternative mechanism for the early-to-late switch"),
 dict(pmid="4357874", year=1973, type="mutant phenotype (the seed claim)", stance="origin of claim",
      claim="D15 is required for late gene expression",
      finding="D15 amber mutants in non-permissive E. coli show virtual absence of late proteins; early enzyme (dNMP kinase) normal. Nick/gap mechanism offered as a proposal",
      context="T5 amD15 on non-permissive E. coli; SDS-PAGE, lysozyme, serum-blocking power",
      confidence="High for the phenotype, none for the mechanism. Readout is protein only, in a replication-dead infection"),
])
ev.to_csv(f"{outdir}/evidence_matrix_D15_late_transcription.csv", index=False)
print("Evidence matrix rows:", len(ev))
print(ev.groupby("stance").size().to_string())

go = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(go_id="GO:0019086", term="late viral transcription", aspect="BP", current="IMP (CACAO) on P06229",
      recommended_action="Do NOT treat as a core function. Downgrade to non-core / downstream phenotype, or remove and replace with the replication terms",
      rationale="The only support is amD15 loss of late proteins (PMID 4357874) in an infection that cannot replicate. The identical phenotype arises from gpD5 loss (PMID 219226) and from a host gyrase block with D15 intact (PMID 2419589). The one direct template test (PMID 1095368) found no nick effect, and interruption-free T5 mutants are viable (PMID 430606)."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0039693", term="viral genome replication", aspect="BP", current="IEA (UniRule)",
      recommended_action="Retain; upgrade evidence to IMP with PMID 4357874 / PMID 904023",
      rationale="D15 is required for T5 genome replication and for concatemer maturation; this is the well-supported core process."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0017108", term="5'-flap endonuclease activity", aspect="MF", current="IDA (UniProtKB)",
      recommended_action="Retain as core MF",
      rationale="Direct assays with defined substrates and crystal structures (PMID 9380501, 9889266, 8657312, 27273516)."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0008409", term="5'-3' exonuclease activity", aspect="MF", current="IDA (UniProtKB)",
      recommended_action="Retain as core MF",
      rationale="Direct kinetic and product analyses (PMID 2211703, 9889266, 17559871)."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0019034", term="viral replication complex", aspect="CC", current="IMP (CACAO)",
      recommended_action="Retain but flag evidence code: the support is co-purification (PMID 6248541), i.e. IDA-type, not IMP",
      rationale="gpD15 co-purifies with RNAP, gpC2, gpD9, gpD5 and protected duplex DNA. JBC 1980 is abstract-only in PubMed (no PMC, no DOI), so the curator should obtain the print article before relying on it."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0033567", term="DNA replication, Okazaki fragment processing", aspect="BP", current="IEA (UniRule)",
      recommended_action="Keep as inferred-by-similarity; do not promote to experimental",
      rationale="Mechanistically plausible from FEN activity but not directly demonstrated for T5 D15 in vivo."),
])
go.to_csv(f"{outdir}/go_decision_table_D15.csv", index=False)
print("\nGO decision rows:", len(go))
print(go[["go_id","term","recommended_action"]].to_string(index=False))

# provenance figure: stance tally
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5,3.4))
order = ["refutes","supports indirect","qualifies","qualifies/refutes","competing","origin of claim"]
counts = ev.stance.value_counts().reindex(order).fillna(0)
colors = ["#E45756","#4C78A8","#F2A93B","#F2A93B","#72B7B2","#9D9D9D"]
ax.barh(range(len(counts)), counts.values, color=colors)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(counts))); ax.set_yticklabels(counts.index)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("number of evidence items")
ax.set_title("Evidence bearing on 'D15 nicks directly license T5 late promoters'")
for sp in ["right","top"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nSaved:", os.listdir(outdir))
